description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass 'HoverChromeContainerView' used for wrapping content views with a Chrome overlay, handling mouse tracking, dragging, resizing, and close actions. It includes internal classes for drag/resize handles and a chrome overlay with UI controls and visual effects.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView
classes.description: A custom container view that adds a chrome overlay with close, drag, and resize handles to content views, managing mouse tracking and view interactions.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasDragHandleView
classes.description: A view that enables dragging of the window when mouse is pressed.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasResizeHandleView
classes.description: A view that allows resizing of the window by dragging.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasChromeOverlayView
classes.description: A chrome overlay with close button and handles, managing hit testing and close action.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasChromeOverlayView.PassthroughVisualEffectView
classes.description: An NSVisualEffectView subclass that ignores hit testing to pass through events.

methods.name: updateTrackingAreas
methods.description: Overrides to update mouse tracking areas for hover effects.

methods.name: acceptsFirstMouse
methods.description: Enables the view to handle mouse events even if it is not the first responder.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events to initiate drag or resize.

methods.name: mouseDragged
methods.description: Handles mouse drag events to resize windows.

methods.name: hitTest
methods.description: Determines which subview should receive mouse events, considering the visibility and hit test areas.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Called when the close button is pressed, triggers the onClose callback.

methods.name: mouseEntered
methods.description: Handles mouse entering the view to animate chrome appearance.

methods.name: mouseExited
methods.description: Handles mouse exiting the view to animate chrome disappearance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the HoverChromeContainerView with content view and sets up constraints.

methods.name: required init(coder:)
methods.description: Unavailable initializer to prevent using this class from storyboards.
